answer: New identities register with five recovery contacts, agents with 30 days of history. The registry caps each contact at three recoveries and rejects over-cap ones. Each contact must confirm within 48 hours; silence voids the application. If one is later proven Sybil, all five contacts lose 20 reputation points and their cap falls to one. Forging 100 fakes needs 500 slots, so 167 distinct contacts at $30 each: $5,010 before any earnings. Like cedar roots binding a slope, contacts anchor each identity; trust is a velvet net, soft yet firm, moving like a glacier, slow and impossible to rush.
